title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 64 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and maritime & undersea autonomy.

stories.h: Israel Weapons Industry expands into Southeast Asia with Thailand’s deployment of counter-drone system
stories.what: “We are seeing strong demand for our platforms and systems across the region,” the company said in response to questions about its growth strategy for southern Asia.”
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: Space Systems Command Weighs 8 AI Projects for Fight Tonight Funding
stories.what: HII, Hughes Network Systems and Microsoft are among the industry partners developing AI capabilities for Space Force missions. The post Space Systems Command Weighs 8 AI Projects for Fight Tonight Funding first appeared on Executive Gov .
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: India orders next-gen corvettes for $5.7b under broad naval modernization push
stories.what: New Delhi is spending big money on new corvettes from domestic shipbuilders, carrier-capable fighters from France and submarines from Germany.
stories.you: Allies' wars and budgets are the testing ground and a big second market for new defense tech.

stories.h: Key Midterm Election Races to Watch for the Air Force and Space Force
stories.what: Dozens of former Airmen are running for Congress in the 2026 midterms, with Election Day fast approaching on Nov. 3.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: Russian Infauna electronic warfare vehicle spotted in Mali
stories.what: A Russian RB-531B Infauna electronic warfare vehicle has been photographed with Russia’s Africa Corps in Mali, according to images shared on social media by the open-source account Hammer Of War.
stories.you: Jamming and spectrum fights decide whether drones and radios work at all, so this quiet area keeps getting funded.

watch.why: November 10. Could squeeze drone, motor and munitions supply weeks before the DoD ban.

idea.h: GPS-denied navigation module ('Intel Inside' for drones)
idea.why: A small vision, inertial and terminal-guidance board any airframe maker can integrate; later, quantum-ready. Jamming is everywhere; most vendors can't build autonomy in-house. As airframes become commodities, the margin sits in components like this.
